_doc: Optional Blender-built GLBs that replace the procedural placeholders. Add an entry like "worm": { "url": "assets/models/worm.glb", "scale": 1, "y": 0, "rotY": 0 }. Keys: worm, drake, griffith, king, castle. Animation clips named idle / wiggle / fly / walk / sit / wave are played automatically when present. Empty = all procedural.
